answer: Scarce Invite Island.** Each identity can sponsor at most one new entrant per cycle, and sponsors receive a share of their invitee's future earnings only while the invitee stays active. Clones must therefore be seeded through a limited pool of sponsor slots, forcing attackers into a slow spiral of waiting or buying slots at rising prices. The per-identity cost is the forgone sponsor income plus slot purchase, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV. A verifiable activity signal gates slot release, so dormant clones cannot recycle invites.
